notes: The later Western Addition A-2 appraisal volumes, SFH371-5014 to 5016, 5018, 5019 and 5024 to 5029 (1963 and 1969-1990): appraisals of single parcels the Agency held or meant to buy, most of them land or buildings already given entries from the 1962-64 appraisals. Their new content is the comparable sales in Haley-Leslie Appraisal Company's 1976-78 reports (5024, 5025): typed paragraphs giving each comparable's address, sale date, price, size, units and rooms. Owners and incomes are not transcribed.

coverage.remaining: Comparable sales on parcels with no page (about 20) are not held: a sale alone does not earn a page and these parcels were not checked against the roll. 5014 (Herbert H. Eling's 1963 appraisals of project blocks 49-53, 85 parcels) lands on five pages, all already carrying the 1962-64 appraisal, and is left unpublished; the single-parcel reports in 5015-5019 and 5026-5029 were scanned for addresses but not read further. Scripts in /mnt/project-files/sfra-acquisition-appraisals/ (later.py, sales_later.py, mkcomps.py).
